methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Blitzpanel is a pre-seed stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Caleb Ho. The valuation analysis draws from a sector universe of 10 private peers in Robotics & Manufacturing, including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics, alongside one public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ).

The peer-median method is not applicable to this valuation. The dataset identifies zero same-stage pre-seed comparables, one adjacent-stage peer, and zero similar-tier valuations within the narrow robotics manufacturing cohort. The analytical threshold requires a minimum of three datapoints to establish a reliable peer median; falling back to all-sector median pricing would introduce substantial distortion given the heterogeneity of robotics subsectors and business models. This methodological gap reflects the thinly populated pre-seed financing landscape in capital-intensive hardware and automation domains.

Given the inapplicability of peer-median triangulation, alternative valuation methods would be required to establish a defensible range—such as revenue multiple analysis (if applicable financial data exists), discounted cash flow modeling, or venture capital method frameworks. The current dataset does not support quantitative synthesis. Key uncertainties include Blitzpanel's revenue traction, capital efficiency profile relative to hardware-stage peers, and whether the single public comparable or the eight private peers offer meaningful valuation anchors given stage and market-timing misalignment. Independent financial data collection is necessary before advancing valuation.
